newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli shekel stable against dollar, basket.
newsitem.headline: Israeli shekel stable against dollar, basket.

text.p: The Israeli shekel representative rate was almost unchanged against the dollar and basket of key foreign currencies on Thursday in dull trade, dealers said.
"Trading was mixed and balanced and activity was low. The shekel was stuck in a narrow range most of the day and the representative rate was almost unchanged," said Zahi Elias of Bank Leumi.
"The basket remained at the lower edge of the trading band and the Bank of Israel did not need to intervene in the market," Elias said.

The shekel is allowed to fluctuate in a trading band of seven percent above or below a sloping mid-point designed to devalue the Israeli currency at a rate of six percent a year against the basket of key currencies.

The representative rate for the dollar was fixed at 3.3210 shekels against 3.3220 on Wednesday. The basket, composed of the dollar, mark, pound sterling, French franc and yen, was fixed at 3.6307 shekels against 3.6297 on Wednesday.
On the crosses the shekel traded against the yen at 2.6836 shekels per 100 yen against 2.6908 on Wednesday and against the mark at 2.0097 shekels against 2.0113 on Wednesday.
In late afternoon the dollar was trading at 3.3180 shekels.
